items.title: LocalStack for Azure Enters Public Preview with Security Settings Stored but Not Enforced
items.summary: LocalStack has opened its Azure emulator to a free public preview, running Azure services locally and accepting existing ARM, Bicep, and Terraform without rewrites. Its own documentation reports partial operation coverage per service and a consistent pattern: configuration is stored and returned, while enforcement of access restrictions, TLS, and network rules is not implemented. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing With Cached Playwright Replays
items.summary: QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing. The agent associates test instructions expressed in natural language to actions on the user interface, caches those when appropriate for faster CI replays, remapping them to test specifications when the user interface changes. Verification is based on multi-model consensus and vision model evaluations. By Bruno Couriol

items.title: How to Make Artificial Intelligence More Environmentally Sustainable
items.summary: IT is responsible for about 2 - 4% of all global emissions, and electricity use at Microsoft and Google has climbed because of AI, according to their own reports. Sustainability ought to be a top-level architectural concern. Some recommendations are: use pre-built and smaller models, run compute where low-carbon electricity is abundant, and train on renewable energy. By Ben Linders
